stem: Sickle cell disease is caused by production of which hemoglobin type?

options.label: A
options.misconception: A normal minor adult hemoglobin is being confused with the sickle variant.
options.explanation: Hemoglobin A2 is a normal minor adult form; sickle disease involves hemoglobin S.

options.label: B
options.misconception: None; sickle cell disease produces abnormal hemoglobin S.
options.explanation: Sickle cell disease is caused by production of abnormal hemoglobin S.

options.label: C
options.misconception: Fetal hemoglobin is being confused with the disease-causing adult variant.
options.explanation: Hemoglobin F is fetal hemoglobin; the sickle variant is hemoglobin S.

options.label: D
options.misconception: Another hemoglobinopathy is being substituted for HbS disease.
options.explanation: Hemoglobin C is a different variant; classic sickle disease is driven by hemoglobin S.

options.label: E
options.misconception: An acquired dyshemoglobin is being confused with inherited HbS.
options.explanation: Methemoglobin is oxidized heme iron; it is not the genetic sickle hemoglobin.

context: Learning objective: identify hemoglobin S as the abnormal hemoglobin in sickle cell disease.
